body.summary: Added the gating test src/db/graph/__tests__/worker-thread-lock.test.ts (with helpers lmdb-worker.mjs and lmdb-open-close.mjs): on a temporary store with the daemon's open options, a real worker thread opens, reads, writes, closes and exits, another process opens and closes, and a separate-process lock check finds the daemon's lock held at every step while the daemon keeps writing. A control test shows the check reports a dropped lock after a stray descriptor on the lock file is closed. Both tests fail under their falsifying mutations (lock dropped mid-sequence; check that always says held). The gate passes, so the Story continues with graph direct.
